traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Characterized by its yellow or ochre cap and white gills and stem. Like other members of the Russula genus, it has a brittle texture. This species forms a mycorrhizal relationship with various trees, and it is often found in coniferous and deciduous forests. It's known for its mild, nutty flavor and is considered a good edible mushroom. As always, proper identification is crucial as there are many species in the Russula genus, some of which may be inedible or have a peppery or bitter taste.
